title: Naturality of currying
statement: For cochain morphisms f : K' ⟶ K, g : L' ⟶ L, and h : M ⟶ M' of sheaf-module complexes over R, and every integer n, the degree-n currying maps commute with the induced contravariant maps in K and L and covariant map in M: precomposition and postcomposition followed by homTensorDegreewiseMap K' L' M' n equals homTensorDegreewiseMap K L M n followed by the map induced by mapBifunctorMap f g and h.
